notes.title: Steam Halloween Sale On Now
notes.notes: The Steam Halloween Sale is on now. Save 50-75% off select spooky titles now through November 1st. Plenty of zombies, ghosts and horror to keep you busy all weekend.

notes.title: Doom Rails Update Released
notes.notes: Doom Rails version 1.1.0 has been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include improved gameplay, configurable controls, controller support and better audio. Minor changes include minor bug fixes, improved visuals and faster loading.
